THE MASTER’S LOG, PART ONE

This document has three pages. The header and the footer come back on each, and each says which page it’s on.

Day | Nautical miles
Monday, Oban to Stornoway | 112
Tuesday, Stornoway to Ullapool | 44
Wednesday, Ullapool to Oban | 118
Total | 274

PART TWO

After a PageBreak: this is page . Fair weather, and a following sea past the Shiants.

Forty-one sailings this month, and three of them late. The third was a matter of a dog, a gangway and an owner who wouldn’t be hurried.

A PAGE OF ITS OWN

With its own background, out to its edges.

[The tide drawn in blue lines under a low sun]
